description: This file contains a class 'Periodic' implementing financial cash flow calculations such as Internal Rate of Return (IRR), Modified IRR (MIRR), and Net Present Value (NPV). These methods are used for financial analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Periodic
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for financial cash flow calculations such as IRR, MIRR, and NPV.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Calculates the internal rate of return (IRR) for a series of cash flows, implementing a numerical root-finding algorithm.

methods.name: modifiedRate
methods.description: Computes the modified internal rate of return (MIRR), considering both finance and reinvestment rates.

methods.name: presentValue
methods.description: Calculates the net present value of a series of cash flows given a discount rate.
